tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
The recorded steps show a full interaction flow on the Magento 1.9 admin Orders grid:
1) Navigate directly to the Orders grid URL (triggering login when needed).
2) Log in using the admin credentials via the login form.
3) On the Orders grid, interact with:
   - A per-row order checkbox (element_hash 4eb9597021) to select an individual order.
   - The 'Select Visible' bulk-selection link (element_hash 0eefac88df) to select all visible rows.
   - The 'Unselect Visible' link (element_hash df76c6ce85 in an earlier state) to clear visible selections.
   - The mass Actions dropdown (element_hash e47b96fe25) to choose a bulk action such as 'Hold'.
   - The 'Submit' button (element_hash e5da8d6705 / 7da645a99b across states) to execute the selected bulk action.
   - The Status filter dropdown in the filter row (element_hash 301a5525e7) to narrow the list to a given order status such as 'Complete'.
   - The 'Search' button (element_hash 90708cd5ce) to apply filters.
   The agent also demonstrated that submitting a mass action with zero selected rows yields a "No order(s) were put on hold." message, and that the items-selected counter updates when using Select Visible.

Task Definition:
Create a reusable tool that, given a desired mass action (e.g., Hold, Cancel, Print Invoices) and optional selection/filter preferences, will:
1) Ensure it is on the Magento Orders grid (including logging in if needed).
2) Optionally filter orders by status before selecting them.
3) Select orders via per-row checkbox and/or Select Visible (which simulates mass-select of current page).
4) Choose the requested mass action from the Actions dropdown.
5) Click Submit to perform the mass action on the selected orders.

This aligns with the original goal: demonstrate and automate mass actions on selected orders (select visible/all, then apply a bulk action).

Action Plan:
1) Navigation to Orders grid:
   - Use a navigation step to go directly to the Orders grid URL.
2) Authentication (if login form appears):
   - Input username 'admin' (fixed credential from instructions).
   - Input password 'password123' (fixed credential).
   - Click the Login button.
   The tool assumes these credentials are constant and not parameterized.
3) Optional filtering by status (parameter-driven):
   - If a status filter value is provided, open the Status filter dropdown (element_hash 301a5525e7) and select the matching visible text option.
   - Click the Search button (element_hash 90708cd5ce) so the grid reloads with orders matching the status.
4) Order selection behavior (parameter-driven):
   - If select_visible is true, click the Select Visible link (element_hash 0eefac88df) to select all visible orders.
   - If select_visible is false, but we still want at least one selection, click one representative per-row checkbox (element_hash 4eb9597021) to select a single order.
   (For this tool, we keep it simple: we either select all visible or just a single example row, driven by a parameter.)
5) Mass action selection:
   - Click the Actions dropdown (element_hash e47b96fe25).
   - Choose the option matching the requested mass action name (e.g., 'Hold', 'Cancel', 'Print Invoices') via select_change using the visible text.
6) Submit action:
   - Click the Submit button (element_hash e5da8d6705) to execute the chosen action.
7) (Optional) Extract confirmation:
   - Use extract_page_content to capture any success or error messages after submitting the action so a caller can inspect the outcome.

Variable Identification:
Based on the behavior, the reusable parameters should be:
- mass_action (string, required): The visible text of the mass action to perform in the Actions dropdown. Must match one of the options: "Cancel", "Hold", "Unhold", "Print Invoices", "Print Packingslips", "Print Credit Memos", "Print All", "Print Shipping Labels".
- select_visible (bool, optional): If true, use the 'Select Visible' link to select all visible orders; if false, select just a single order via checkbox.
- filter_status (string, optional): Visible text of the Status to filter by before selection (e.g., "Complete", "Pending", "Processing"). When provided, the tool will set this in the Status filter dropdown and click Search.

We deliberately do NOT parameterize:
- Username and password (fixed by instructions).
- Grid URL (fixed starting URL).
- Row-specific IDs or order numbers, since the demonstration and task focus on bulk operations on whatever is visible/filtered, not on particular orders.

Step Optimization:
- Navigation: Direct navigation to http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_order/ is sufficient; no need to traverse menus.
- Authentication: Use deterministic input steps referencing element_hashes collected on the login page:
  - Username input element_hash 3597a5c5e6.
  - Password input element_hash 1c47a5217e.
  - Login button element_hash 6831836d17.
- On the Orders grid, use deterministic interactions via element_hash instead of index-only clicks to ensure stability:
  - Example per-row checkbox: 4eb9597021.
  - Select Visible link: 0eefac88df.
  - Actions dropdown: e47b96fe25.
  - Submit button: e5da8d6705.
  - Status filter dropdown: 301a5525e7.
  - Search button: 90708cd5ce.
- No agentic steps are strictly necessary because all required elements have stable element_hash IDs from prior interactions and the grid layout is static.
- Filtering and sorting: The goal statement says to explore filters/sorting, but the primary automation task is mass actions. We'll include only a simple Status filter, which was explicitly used in the final demo. We skip sort interactions to keep the tool focused.
- URL manipulation is not appropriate for these POST-based form actions (selection + mass update relies on form submission with POST and grid state), so we keep UI interactions instead of URL parameter rewriting.

Because the website requires a mass action to be chosen and at least one order selected for the action to be meaningful, mass_action is required and at least one selection mechanism must be used. We enforce selection through the select_visible flag (true selects all; false selects one row).

Input Schema Justification:
- mass_action: required, matches dropdown visible text, directly controls which bulk operation the tool performs.
- select_visible: optional boolean that controls whether to select all visible orders or only a single example row.
- filter_status: optional string for Status filter; filters are not mandatory for executing mass actions, so this remains optional.

The final tool is a single-purpose, sequential automation that demonstrates and replays the core workflow: filter (optional) -> select orders -> choose action -> submit and observe outcome.
name: magento_admin_orders_mass_action
description: Perform mass actions on selected orders in the Magento 1.x Admin Orders grid: select individual or visible orders, choose a bulk action (cancel/hold/unhold/print documents), optionally filter by status, and submit the mass action.

steps.description: Navigate directly to the Magento Admin Orders grid URL (may show login page if not authenticated).
Enter the fixed admin username into the login form username field, if the login page is shown.
Enter the fixed admin password into the login form password field, if the login page is shown.
Click the Login button to authenticate and proceed to the Orders grid.
Wait for the Orders grid to load after login or navigation.
If a filter_status value is provided, set the Status filter dropdown in the grid filter row to that status. If filter_status is empty, this step will effectively be a no-op.
Click the Search button to apply filters (such as Status) and refresh the Orders grid.
Wait for the filtered Orders grid to reload after clicking Search.
Click a representative per-row order checkbox to select an individual order for the mass action.
Click the 'Select Visible' link to select all currently visible orders on the grid (used when select_visible is true).
Focus the Actions dropdown that controls the mass actions for selected orders.
Choose the desired mass action (e.g., Hold, Cancel, Print Invoices) from the Actions dropdown using the provided mass_action visible text.
Click the Submit button to execute the selected mass action on the selected orders.
Wait for the grid to refresh and any success/error system messages to appear after submitting the mass action.
Extract page content to allow the caller to inspect the outcome of the submitted mass action.
steps.goal: Capture any success or error system messages and a brief summary of the Orders grid state after the mass action (e.g., number of items selected, presence of notices like 'No order(s) were put on hold.').

input_schema.name: mass_action
input_schema.description: Visible text of the mass action to perform from the Actions dropdown. Must be one of: "Cancel", "Hold", "Unhold", "Print Invoices", "Print Packingslips", "Print Credit Memos", "Print All", "Print Shipping Labels".

input_schema.name: select_visible
input_schema.description: Whether to use the 'Select Visible' link to select all visible orders (true) or only select a single example order via its checkbox (false). Defaults to true if omitted.

input_schema.name: filter_status
input_schema.description: Optional visible text of the Status to filter by before selecting orders (e.g., "Complete", "Pending", "Processing"). If provided, the tool sets this value in the Status filter dropdown and clicks Search before selecting orders.
